summary: Kazia Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of James Levine as Chief Financial Officer effective June 1, 2026. The appointment is a routine C-suite change, not a forced or abrupt departure; the prior CFO was not mentioned. The filing details the employment terms, including an annual base salary of US$475,000, a 40% target bonus, and 200,000 ADS options. Because this is a voluntary, planned appointment rather than a sudden departure constituting the event itself, the category is Management Changes. No deal terms apply.
